about: MyDay's own list of the Arabic course's checkpoint and study-method skills: the orientation module and the four consolidation modules (A1, A2, B1, B2). Their lessons stay on your path in order, but they are never suggested as catch-up for a lesson that builds on them, because revisiting a portfolio or a goal-setting lesson doesn't repair grammar or vocabulary. Authored for adaptive Study (specs/study-home-and-lessons.md §8); the course package is unchanged. app/scripts/prepare-arabic.mjs checks it at every build.
